reviewerRole: Fresh fallback provisional internal SSCTR; native specialist role unavailable
scope: Current scientific-boundary/runtime binding only; not whole-domain, autonomous-coach, production or clinical readiness

findings.title: Current effort and contradictory response cannot be overwritten by historical familiarity
findings.description: Current code gives adverse/negated information precedence, rejects maximal familiar work outside the envelope and checks recovery, technique and comparability before progression.

findings.title: Complete task must fit actual available time
findings.description: Run planning includes preparation, work, recoveries and cooldown. Unknown self-paced stride recovery cannot falsely fit a supplied tight window. Same-dose placement is checked against actual local-time windows. Strength reservations are logistical estimates, not physiological requirements or forced cadence.

findings.title: Re-establishment uses current compatible easy evidence rather than hard or contradictory demonstrations
findings.description: Known nonclinical logistics return can use a bounded easy entry. Current demonstrated reuse is limited by current function, a nonmaximal effort cue, correct family and available time; elapsed days do not restore former capacity.

findings.title: Changed environment cannot silently retain an old controlled pace or stride task
findings.description: Explicit noncomparable terrain/conditions or unsafe/unestablished surface prevents positive reuse of the familiar anchor. No flat-pace or remote-race crosswalk is approved.

findings.title: Minimal supported change uses the actual known equipment increment
findings.description: Larger load changes are rejected when a smaller actual increment is supplied; one noisy strength observation does not earn a progression. This is contextual equipment logic, not a universal numeric progression rule.

findings.title: Substitution and equipment need an unambiguous executable basis
findings.description: Separately familiar alternatives require their own effort/rest and unambiguous dumbbell per-hand basis. Explicit bodyweight-only/no-dumbbell constraints cannot produce a loaded dumbbell row. No automatic kilogram conversion is used.

findings.title: Clinical and scientific authority boundaries remain binding
findings.description: Clinical/current eligibility guards and exact independent envelope authority prevent unsupported positive binding. All 30 probes preserve official/applied plan equality; generated recommendations remain offline proposals.

findings.title: Excluded population metadata must not disappear behind general nonclinical eligibility
findings.description: Additional population/eligibility fields require reconciliation against the reviewed applicability contract; an excluded pregnancy context cannot inherit the ordinary adult envelope. No disease or clearance is inferred.

findings.title: Learned associations cannot approve self-declared prescriptions
findings.description: The current runtime fails closed with LEARNED_OPTION_ADMISSIBILITY_CONTRACT until a reusable material candidate-admissibility/equal-dose contract is implemented. Associative preference remains advisory. This is an owned domain binding gap, not a demand for a paper approving every generated dose.

findings.title: Resolved input is not repeatedly counted as useful ASK
findings.description: The original unknown recovery construct remains ASK. When both requested facts are supplied, the unresolved selector becomes NOT_SUPPORTED_DOMAIN_GAP / SUPPLIED_FACTS_REQUIRE_COACHING_BINDING with no missing inputs or new positive output. Scientific scope is unchanged.

findings.title: Finite source vocabulary and designed-case evidence
findings.description: The controlled narrative/source adapter and synthetic cases do not establish arbitrary natural-language interpretation, V1 population coverage or real-world coaching effectiveness. New source vocabulary, live data and population expansion require their own validation.

findings.title: No universal optimality or precise individual physiological learner
findings.description: Ordinal goal/phase/context ranking is reviewable coaching judgment inside the bounded alternatives. It does not prove universal optimality, individual causal response traits, exact RIR accuracy or validated future adaptation gains. Learned associations currently advise preference only; executable task selection from those associations remains domain-blocked pending a reusable material admissibility binding.

findings.title: Retained substantive domain/science gaps
findings.description: Novel uncalibrated VO2/hills/race targets, reviewed complete combined taper, broader week programming and clinical/special-population scope remain outside this approval. Their persistence must remain explicit in R4 readiness and open-gap reports.

conditions: Applies only to the current exact nine r2 envelope authorities and reviewed offline synthetic adult nonclinical recreational novice/intermediate scope; no production, KMP, UI/Figma or real-person plan mutation.

Scientific review constrains the principles and admissible option space. Concrete selection within those bounds may use defensible coaching composition without a separate exact-dose paper or queue entry for every instance.

Keep approximate RIR, current effort/function and technique checkpoints, walk/stop options, contextual MEC, scheduling feasibility and future response review explicit. Operational timing reservations never force completion or cadence.
Maintain the reusable-rule future-human queue: 110 current entries, nine R4 approvals at exact r2 targets/conditions, funding NOT_DECLARED; qualified-human and clinical boundaries remain unchanged.

Do not treat runtime COACHING_BEST_SUPPORTED self-check labels or this scientific binding review as the independent full coaching-quality verdict. Use the separate quality review and report residual gaps without forced GO.

Material changes to reviewed envelope, selector, authority binding, source interpretation, scope or decisive evidence invalidate affected conclusions. Preserve historical decisions and obtain fresh review for those changes.

proof.independentSourceAuthorship: Reviewer did not author or edit judged envelope/runtime. Reviewer authored the targeted supporting source synthesis; no separate source-fidelity judge is implied.

expiry: Immediate for a material change to any reviewed scientific target or dependent selector/context/population; funded-human revalidation follows actual Founder declaration.
